lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh saran jagadeesur piaare mohi saradhaa poor har gusaaee ||
lines.translation: Keep me under Your Protection, O Beloved Master of the Universe; fulfill my faith, O Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kai man anad hot hai har darasan nimakh dikhaaee ||2||39||13||15||67||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he beholds the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||39||13||15||67||
Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin laaee preet soee phir khaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who loves her, is ultimately devoured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਠਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin sukh baithaalee tis bhau bahut dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who seats her in comfort, is totally terrified by her.
Siblings, friends and family, beholding her, argue.
But she has come under my control, by Guru's Grace. ||1||
Beholding her, all are bewitched:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhik sidh suradev manukhaa bin saadhoo sabh dhrohan dhrohe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: the strivers, the Siddhas, the demi-gods, angels and mortals. All, except the Saadhus, are deceived by her deception. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik phirahi udaasee tinh kaam viaapai ||
lines.translation: Some wander around as renunciates, but they are engrossed in sexual desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sa(n)chahi girahee tinh hoi na aapai ||
lines.translation: Some grow rich as householders, but she does not belong to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਲਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik satee kahaavahi tinh bahut kalapaavai ||
lines.translation: Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ham har raakhe lag satigur paavai ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||
She leads astray the penitents who practice penance.
The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.
The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ham satigur raakhe de kar haath ||3||
lines.translation: The True Guru has saved me, by giving me His Hand. ||3||
She is the slave of those who are spiritually wise.
With her palms pressed together, she serves them and offers her prayer:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo too(n) kahahi s kaar kamaavaa ||
lines.translation: "Whatever you wish, that is what I shall do."

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak guramukh neR na aavaa ||4||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, she does not draw near to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
I have been separated from my Beloved by Maya (my mother-in-law).
Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are dying of grief.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਜਿਠੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ke jithere kee chookee kaan ||
lines.translation: I am no longer swayed by the fear of Death (my elder brother-in-law).
I am protected by my All-knowing, Wise Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunahu lokaa mai prem ras paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, O people: I have tasted the elixir of love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: durajan maare vairee sa(n)ghaare satigur mo kau har naam divaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The evil ones are dead, and my enemies are destroyed. The True Guru has given me the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
First, I renounced my egotistical love of myself.
Second, I renounced the ways of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun tiaag durajan meet samaane ||
lines.translation: Renouncing the three qualities, I look alike upon friend and enemy.
And then, the fourth state of bliss was revealed to me by the Holy One. ||2||
In the cave of celestial bliss, I have obtained a seat.
The Lord of Light plays the unstruck melody of bliss.
I am in ecstasy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pri siu raatee dhan sohaagan naar ||3||
lines.translation: Imbued with my Beloved Husband Lord, I am the blessed, happy soul-bride. ||3||
Servant Nanak chants the wisdom of God;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sune kamaavai s utarai paar ||
lines.translation: one who listens and practices it, is carried across and saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam na marai na aavai na jaai ||
lines.translation: He is not born, and he does not die; he does not come or go.
He remains blended with the Lord. ||4||2||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
The bride shows such special devotion, and has such an agreeable disposition.
Her beauty is incomparable, and her character is perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit grihi vasai so grihu sobhaava(n)taa ||
lines.translation: The house in which she dwells is such a praiseworthy house.
But rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain that state||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਮ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukaranee kaaman gur mil ham paaee ||
lines.translation: As the soul-bride of pure actions, I have met with the Guru.
